rationale: P identifies braking behavior itself, which must be characterised to evaluate SG-3's prevention of unintended braking. H-3 supports the operational restrictions and hazardous braking case, while FR-7 supports distinguishing intended obstacle-avoidance braking from unintended braking. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Whether braking occurs as intended or unintentionally” directly addresses the Evaluation Target rather than a mechanism used to evaluate it.
Straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, in good weather and without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, matches H-3's operational situation.
Including braking and non-braking cases characterises the occurrence or absence of the behavior relevant to SG-3.
Obstacle-related braking is expressly limited to the declared scope and provides an intended-braking contrast supported by FR-7, without adding obstacle-detection or control mechanisms to P.
